notes: The ASV reorders my beloved Son: the possessive is on μου, the first article is unrepresented under rule 20, and the second attributive article under rule 23.
ἐκ takes out of whole as its own English gloss, so τῶν keeps a bare the; rule 106 names ἐκ → out of as the preposition's gloss.
εὐδόκησα heads on pleased, the word answering to the compound's core, with well answering to the εὐ- element under rule 66 and rule 104's εὐάρεστος → well pleasing precedent.
The margin's alternative punctuation does not change which token each English word answers to.
